Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + POC readiness plan — OrionTech

Hi Alex / Samira — great conversation today, thanks for the time.  Below is a concise recap and proposed next steps so we can get a 2-week technical POC started next week.  I kept this tight so your engineering and security teams can scan quickly.

Key pain points you called out:
- Latency spikes and tail latency variability with your current hosted model endpoints (especially for multi-turn chat flows).
- High per-token bill impacting API-driven features in your product.
- Need for data residency controls and VPC isolation for customer-identifiable data.

Top-level POC goals (what success looks like)
- Reduce per-response cost by >= 2.5x for baseline prompt set (same quality tolerance).
- Achieve 95th percentile latency < 200 ms for short-context chat flows (<= 512 tokens).
- Validate private deployment path (VPC + KMS) with redacted sample data.

Proposed POC scope (what Redwood will provide)
- Two-week pilot: hosted dedicated capacity + private VPC proof-of-concept for a single model variant.
- Shared prompt set (we'll run the same evals you run) and observable metrics (token cost, latency p50/p95, correctness by eval suite).
- Quick quantization/throughput suggestions and caching/batching configuration for your traffic profile.

Immediate asks from OrionTech (what we need to start)
- Redacted sample dataset (<= 5k rows) or a representative prompt set (S3 link or Drive).
- Short-lived API creds for a sandbox environment OR read-only S3 access (see access_matrix.xlsx attached).
- Security questionnaire point-person (you mentioned Samira).

Proposed timeline / owners
- Week 0 (this week): sign mutual action plan + share data + confirm kickoff date (owner: Alex).
- Week 1: infra setup, access, baseline measurements (owners: Michael + Karthik).
- Week 2: tuning, prompt evals, final readout (owners: Laura + Aditya).

Attachments: mvp_scope_v1.pdf (POC scope + success criteria), access_matrix.xlsx (access checklist).  I've uploaded both to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OrionTech-POC.

Questions / options for you to confirm:
1) Is a 2-week technical POC still acceptable, or would you prefer a 3-week ramp for additional evals?
2) Do you want Redwood to run evaluations on your sample dataset or run them on our side with redacted inputs?

If that looks good I can draft a short mutual action plan and target a kickoff on Monday 2026-05-25.

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

- For the sample dataset: we can provide a redacted S3 bucket and short-lived creds. I need to confirm exact IAM policy we should give.
